notes.irrbbEveSensitivityPct: National Bank discloses only a single +/-100bp parallel shock (not the full 6-scenario Basel/OSFI framework). Most adverse = +100bp increase scenario, EVE impact -$366M (before tax, total CAD+other currencies) as at Jul 31 2024, per 'Interest Rate Sensitivity - Non-Trading Activities' table. Bank does not itself express this as a %; computed here as -$366M / Tier 1 capital $21,855M (CC1 table, Q1 2025 supplementary disclosure trend column).
notes.irrbbNiiSensitivityPct: Most adverse = -100bp decrease scenario, NII impact -$114M (before-tax, 12-month projection). +100bp scenario impact was +$80M. Computed as % of Tier 1 capital ($21,855M) for comparability; bank does not publish this as a ratio.

notes.roa: Disclosed by the issuer, ADJUSTED basis: 0.83% adjusted return on average assets for Q3 2024, read from the Q2 2026 supplementary financial information (page 7), row "Return on average assets (3) – adjusted (4)" -- the reported row above it is what this dataset previously used. notes.rotce: COMPUTED on an ADJUSTED basis -- NATIONAL publishes no ROTCE. Uses the issuer's ADJUSTED net income so it lines up with the four banks that publish an adjusted ROTCE. Caveat: the goodwill deduction is a period-end balance against an average equity base, since neither bank publishes an average deduction.
notes.equityMultiplier: Computed from two disclosed figures: average total assets $461,504M divided by average common equity $21,539M = 21.43x. Both operands are published in the issuer's own financial supplementary information. Average COMMON equity is the denominator so the DuPont identity holds against the ROE and ROA already in this dataset (ROA x multiplier is approximately ROE).
notes.adjustedDilutedEps: Disclosed: $2.68 adjusted diluted earnings per share for Q3 2024. National Bank supplementary financial information p6, row "diluted earnings per share - adjusted". Adjusted measures remove each issuer's own items of note, so the adjustments differ between banks even though every figure here is the bank's own published number.
notes.lcrBufferBillions: COMPUTED: high-quality liquid assets less total net cash outflows -- the cushion above the 100% LCR requirement. HQLA $80,724.0M less net cash outflows $53,799.0M = $26.9B. Both operands are disclosed in the issuer's LCR common disclosure template (page 38), and the pair reproduces the LCR percentage printed on that same page. irrbbDisclosureNote: National Bank discloses IRRBB via a single 'Interest Rate Sensitivity - Non-Trading Activities (Before Tax)' table, published every quarter in the Report to Shareholders MD&A Risk Management section (and annually in the Annual Report), rather than the full Basel/OSFI six-scenario standardized framework (parallel up/down, steepener, flattener, short-rate up/down) some larger Canadian peers disclose. It shows only one prescribed shock: an immediate and sustained parallel +/-100bp shift in interest rates. Both Economic Value of Equity impact and projected 12-month Net Interest Income impact are shown, before tax, split between Canadian-dollar and other-currency books, calculated daily and assuming no further hedging. Unlike the Basel IRRBB outlier-test convention (15% of Tier 1/CET1), National Bank reports these sensitivities strictly in absolute CAD-millions dollar terms, never as a percentage of any capital base; its own Supplementary Regulatory Capital and Pillar 3 Disclosure package explicitly cross-references the IRRBB disclosure to specific pages of the Report to Shareholders/Annual Report rather than including a standalone Basel IRRBB1 template of its own.
